statewide_source.service: WV_Parcels MapServer on services.wvgis.wvu.edu (WV GIS Technical Center for the WV State Tax Department Property Tax Division; the service behind the WV Property Viewer, mapwv.gov/parcel), no token needed

layers.11 ParcelSummary: tax-roll table (no geometry): Owner1/Owner2, DeedBook/DeedPage, NewOwner/NewBook/NewPage, TaxYear, DeededAcres, property class, appraisal

statewide_source.county_filter: layer 0: CountyID='01'..'55'; table 11: CountyCode=1..55 (alphabetical, McDowell=27 sorts before Mercer)
caveats: Layer 0 description says "updated for Tax Year 2023"; its OWNER1 differs from the 2026 table in 3 of 55 samples, so use table 11 for owner/deed.
DeedBook and DeedPage are 4-character fields; book type prefixes are packed in (e.g. WB5, 0WB5, AB13, EB 1, IS81, FB05, DB13, GB58, A542) so longer refs can be cut off.
Table has ~1.5M rows vs 1.39M polygons: tax parcels without mapped polygons plus a few multi-card duplicates (take the first row per CleanParcelID).
NewOwner/NewBook/NewPage populated on ~39,000 records (transfers recorded after the tax roll).
statewide_source.use_terms: Service description: provided as a public service, as is, without warranties; county assessor and clerk records should be consulted for verification.

_meta.deed_formats: DeedBook/DeedPage are separate 4-char strings. Most books are plain numbers (some zero-padded, e.g. 0539/0482). Many counties mix in book-type prefixes: WB (will book, all counties), AB, AP, FB/FD/FID (fiduciary), EB (Mason, Monongalia), IS (Morgan), HA (Marion), R (Raleigh), OR/AR (Tyler), A/W/E/M single-letter series (Cabell, Marion, Marshall, Monongalia, Preston, Wetzel, Wood), and junk values (NONE, XXXX, DEAT). Per-county prefix counts in wv_work/deed_formats.json.
_meta.excluded_false_hits: None used. AGOL county copies seen in search (NicholasWV_AGOL, BraxtonAGOL, MingoAGOL, RitchieAGOL, McdowellWVAGOL) were not needed and not verified.

status_legend.partial: owner+PID (no deed), geometry+PID only, or subset (city/project) coverage
status_legend.unverified: endpoint unreachable, token-locked, or attribute queries failing at test time
